title: Sustained Russian drone/missile strikes on Ukraine

rationale: Multiple recent strikes on Kyiv, cities, refineries and steel plants (e.g., "Russian drone hits central Kyiv...", "Russia's Perm oil refinery halted...", "Russian strikes shut Ukraine's biggest steelmaker").

title: Ongoing Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and logistics
rationale: Reports of Ukraine striking Russian refinery, train, and oil facilities ("Ukraine kills two in drone attacks on Russia, hits oil refinery and train", "Ukraine says it struck Russian oil refinery").

title: NATO steps up intelligence-sharing and limited capability transfers
rationale: Headlines: "NATO steps up intelligence-sharing...", "US to provide critical but more limited capabilities to NATO."

title: Campaign against data centres and mobile networks
rationale: Headlines report strikes on data centres and Ukraine's largest mobile provider ("Russia targets Ukraine’s data centres", "Russia hits Ukraine's largest mobile provider").

title: Spread of drone/missile swarm tactics

title: Hybrid warfare and cyber escalation forecast
